Gladstone.bio: Dr. Bushra Inayat Khan is a seasoned General Practitioner with 19 years of extensive experience in the medical field. She holds an MBBS degree and is a Member of the Royal College of General Practitioners (MRCGP), reflecting her high level of expertise and commitment to excellence in general practice. Dr. Bushra has had a diverse international career experience has provided her with a broad perspective on healthcare and a deep understanding of different medical practices and patient needs. Her areas of interest are wide-ranging and include women’s health, children’s health, aged care, and aesthetic medicine. Dr. Bushra is dedicated to offering comprehensive and personalized care to her patients, ensuring they receive the highest standard of medical treatment. Personal Statement: “Committed to delivering compassionate and personalized healthcare, focusing on the unique needs of each patient.” Gladstone

Dr Mehwish Javaid is a dedicated and experienced General Practitioner who provides comprehensive care to patients of all ages. She holds an MBBS, MCPS in Family Medicine, MRCGP (International), and a Diploma in Family Medicine and Mental Health. Dr Mehwish has a strong interest in women’s health, mental health, preventive care, and the management of common acute and ongoing health conditions. She takes a holistic approach to care and works closely with her patients to support their overall wellbeing. Known for her compassionate and patient-centred approach, Dr Mehwish is committed to creating a respectful and supportive environment where patients feel comfortable discussing their health concerns. Gladstone

Dr. Mohammad Umair Siddiquiis a highly experienced General Practitioner with nearly two decades of experience in the medical field. Dr. Siddiqui’s comprehensive qualifications include an MBBS, MPH, GDipOccEnvMed, and he is a Fellow of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP). Throughout his career, Dr. Siddiqui has been dedicated to providing exceptional patient care, driven by his philosophy of excellence with empathy. His commitment to holistic and patient-centred care ensures that each patient receives personalized attention and the highest standard of medical service. Gladstone

Dr. Saiqa Syedais a highly experienced and compassionate General Practitioner with a distinguished career spanning over 12 years. She earned her MBBS and BSc degrees and is a Fellow of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP), underscoring her commitment to excellence in primary care. Since joining the GP Ultrahub team in 2022, Dr. Syeda has continued to provide exceptional healthcare services, building on her extensive experience in the Gladstone community where she has practiced since 2019. Her dedication to her patients is evident in her comprehensive approach to healthcare, addressing a wide range of medical needs with a particular focus on general practice, women’s health, mental health, and skin cancer management. Dr. Syeda is deeply committed to a patient-first philosophy, ensuring that each patient receives personalized, high-quality care. She adopts a holistic approach to medicine, emphasizing the importance of treating the whole person rather than just their symptoms. This patient-centreed approach fosters trust and ensures that her patients feel heard, respected, and well-cared for. Gladstone

Dr Arooj Fatima is a dedicated general practitioner with over 8 years of experience spanning primary care, emergency medicine, and paediatric oncology. She has a special interest in women’s and child health, focusing on holistic and compassionate care that addresses the unique needs of families. Her passion for continuous learning and improving patient care is reflected in her extensive research contributions, with publications on cancer and preventive health. Dr Fatima has been recognized for her excellence in medicine with numerous prestigious awards, including a Young Investigator Award and a Gold Medal for Outstanding Healthcare Achievements. In 2025, she joined GP Ultra Hub, where her patient-centered approach and expertise in preventive care empower individuals and families to achieve better health outcomes. Dr. Fatima remains committed to personalized, evidence-based care, fostering trust and well-being for her patients and community. Gladstone

Dr. Muhammad Arif is a distinguished General Practitioner with over 15 years ofinternational clinical experience in General Practice and Internal Medicine, gained through service in reputable healthcare institutions across diverse healthcare settings. He holds an MBBS degree and the esteemed MRCGP qualification, underscoring his strong clinical foundation and commitment to excellence in primary care. His areas of expertise include the comprehensive management of acute and chronic healthconditions,delivered through a patient-centred, evidence-based approach that prioritises safety and continuity of care. Dr. Arif’s clinical strengths also encompass child health, preventive care, and the evaluation and management of mental health conditions, ensuring holistic and equitable care for patients of all ages. With extensive multicultural experience and an unwavering dedication to ongoing professional development, Dr. Muhammad Arif continues to provide high-quality primary healthcare grounded in compassion, clinical precision, and ethical practice. Gladstone

Burnett Heads.bio: Dr. Carem Au completed her Bachelor of Medicine / Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) at The University of Queensland in 2014 and went on to achieve Fellowship with The Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP) in 2021. Over the past few years, Dr. Au has worked extensively as a locum GP across Australia, gaining broad experience in all aspects of general practice before settling with GP UltraHub in Burnett Heads. She has a special interest in women’s health, children’s health, skin checks, skin cancer medicine and excisions, while also providing comprehensive care for patients and families across all stages of life. Gladstone

Dr Rezwan Alam is a dedicated General Practitioner with over 12 years of clinical experience, focused on delivering high-quality, patient-centred care. He takes a holistic approach to health, working closely with patients to achieve better long-term outcomes.He holds Membership of the Royal College of General Practitioners (MRCGP, UK) and has a broad clinical background, enabling him to manage a wide range of acute and chronic conditions with evidence-based, compassionate care. Dr Alam has a strong interest in all areas of general practice, particularly chronic disease management, including diabetes, hypertension, obesity, and cardiac and respiratory conditions. He also provides care across adult and elderly health, mental health, women’s health, children’s health, men’s health, and preventive care.He is committed to building strong doctor–patient relationships and ensuring every patient feels heard, informed, and supported.Outside of work, Dr Alam enjoys travelling, cricket, and spending time with family and friends.
